Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.interaction

Class MilkTransfers

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.interaction.MilkTransfers
public final class MilkTransfers extends Object
Milk-specific held-transfer rules shared by every loader. Milk is not a Forge or NeoForge fluid or a Fabric FluidVariant, so it is moved as plain BucketState amounts and vanilla milk buckets instead of through a loader fluid system.

    • milkCow

      public static boolean milkCow(net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Cow cow, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand)
      Milks cow through its own interaction, so vanilla and modded mobInteract behavior — the milking sound, any cooldown, a replaced drop — decides the outcome. A one-count vanilla bucket stands in for the caller's bucket for the duration of the call and is swapped back afterward; the caller records the milk unit on its own stack. A milk bucket that Cow.mobInteract hands a creative player via ItemUtils.createFilledResult is removed again, since this helper only reports the milking.
      Parameters:
      cow - cow to milk
      player - acting player; a one-count vanilla bucket is swapped into hand for the call
      hand - hand holding the caller's bucket
      Returns:
      true iff the cow interaction consumed the action
